title: Signed-in floating action menu, clock-style viewer timer, Shorts branding, and ≤5s Live refresh

requirements.summary: Add a signed-in-only floating “+” button with an action menu that navigates to Upload Video, Upload Short, or Go Live flows.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the floating + button is not visible.
When the user is authenticated, a circular floating + button is visible at bottom-right on all main routes (Home, Shorts, Live, Watch, Upload).
Clicking/tapping the + button opens a menu with exactly: Upload Video, Upload Short, Go Live.
Choosing Upload Video opens the existing upload flow pre-selected for long-form video.
Choosing Upload Short opens the existing upload flow pre-selected for short.
Choosing Go Live navigates to the existing Live page and opens the start-live flow (or focuses the existing Go Live action).
All user-facing labels are in English.

file_operations.description: Create a fixed bottom-right circular “+” button that is only rendered when the user is authenticated (via useInternetIdentity). Implement a small in-place menu with exactly three English actions (Upload Video, Upload Short, Go Live) and use TanStack Router navigation to route into existing flows. Use shadcn-ui primitives (e.g., Button/Card or similar) to match styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new FloatingActionButton into the global layout so it appears on all main routes while keeping it hidden for guests. Ensure fixed positioning does not overlap essential UI and respects z-index above page content. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Read a URL parameter (e.g., mediaType=video|short) and pass it down to the existing UploadForm so the upload flow opens pre-selected for long-form video or short based on the FloatingActionButton selection. Keep all user-facing text in English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add support for an initial/preselected media type provided by UploadPage (e.g., via a prop) so the radio selection defaults correctly for Upload Video vs Upload Short. Maintain current behavior when no preselection is provided. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Support navigation-triggered opening of the existing start-live UI (e.g., via a URL parameter like startLive=1): auto-open the start form when present and focus the title input so the user can immediately start a live session. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Reuse/extend existing URL parameter utilities if needed to support reading the Upload mediaType preselection and the Live startLive trigger consistently across query/hash routing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Replace Watch-page viewer timer minutes/seconds inputs with clock-style From/To time selection and compute countdown duration from the range.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer timer UI provides two clock-style inputs (From and To) for selecting times (e.g., using time pickers or hour/minute selectors).
Starting the timer computes a positive duration based on the selected range; if the range is invalid (e.g., To not after From), show an English validation message and do not start.
While active, the timer displays remaining time and provides a stop/cancel action.
When the timer reaches zero, the existing onTimerEnd behavior triggers and the video pauses as before.

file_operations.description: Update the timer UI to use two clock-style time inputs (From and To) and compute the countdown duration from the selected range. Add English validation messaging for invalid ranges, preserve the existing countdown/stop behavior, and continue calling onTimerEnd exactly when reaching zero. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm WatchPage continues to pass the same onTimerEnd behavior into ViewerTimer so that the video pauses when the timer reaches zero, with no behavioral regressions after the ViewerTimer UI change. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add prominent Shorts-specific branding text in the Shorts page header indicating users can watch Shorts.
acceptanceCriteria: The Shorts page header includes a prominent “Shorts” branding element (e.g., badge/lockup) in addition to the page title.
The branding element includes English text that indicates watching Shorts (e.g., subtitle/tagline) without changing app functionality.
No backend changes are required for this branding element.

file_operations.description: Enhance the Shorts header area with a clear, prominent text-based branding element that says “Shorts” and includes an English watch-oriented line (e.g., a tagline such as 'Watch Shorts'). Keep functionality unchanged and avoid introducing new images. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Poll/refetch active live sessions while Live page is open with an interval of 5 seconds or less.
acceptanceCriteria: While the Live page is open, the list of active live sessions is automatically refreshed on an interval of ≤ 5 seconds.
Starting or ending a live session becomes visible to another user on the Live page within 5 seconds (assuming normal network conditions).
This refresh behavior does not require real-time sockets/websockets and uses the existing query/actor APIs.

file_operations.description: Update the live sessions query hook used by LivePage (useGetAllActiveLiveSessions) to automatically refetch/poll on an interval of 5 seconds or less while mounted, using React Query options (e.g., refetchInterval). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
